plainLanguageRule: Tell Wizards what happens by data category and timing. Do not say all data is deleted immediately, and do not expose internal queue/table terminology in user-facing copy.

categories.behavior: Access ends immediately and cannot be recovered. Creator profile is anonymized/private; profile avatar and bio are removed from the active profile.
categories.backendNote: Wand account becomes deleted; AuthIdentity is retired and session cutoff advances.

categories.behavior: Owned works are removed from Community access and discovery immediately. User-authored payload such as media and Preset payload is physically purged within 7 days unless an allowed retention hold applies.
Authored comments are deleted/anonymized in place so conversation structure can remain without the original comment text.

categories.userLabel: Saves, follows, reactions, notifications and linked DDV profiles
categories.behavior: Private interaction state and linked DDV profiles are removed as part of account deletion.

Wand access and sessions are revoked immediately. Deletion at the authentication provider is processed asynchronously with retry; the original provider identifier is not retained in public Community tables.
Operational detail is normally deleted or minimized at 90 days after account deletion.
categories.exception: Moderation, security or legal retention hold may delay the applicable scrub only while justified.

categories.behavior: Minimal non-content identifiers and relationship/revision structure may remain where needed to preserve database, publication, moderation or audit integrity. Deleted user-authored payload and unnecessary re-identifying detail are not retained for this purpose.
Backup copies follow a separate recovery policy. Restores are quarantined and deletion reconciliation must run before restored Community data can become user-visible.

Some authentication, infrastructure and transactional-email copies/logs are held by service providers under their own retention windows. Wand minimizes data sent to providers and discloses material provider-controlled retention.

mustState: account/Creator/owned works disappear from Community access immediately
user-authored payload is purged within 7 days
some operational records are normally minimized at 90 days
moderation/security/legal holds and backup/provider copies may follow separate rules
mustNotState: all copies are physically deleted immediately
the 7-day period is a recovery window
the 90-day period applies to user-authored content payload
